description: This file implements the LifecycleManager class for a plugin in the WPEFramework. It manages application lifecycle events, registration of notifications, application spawning, termination, and state transitions, and handles events from runtime and window managers.

classes.name: LifecycleManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements the ILifecycleManager and ILifecycleManagerState interfaces, managing application lifecycle events, notifications, and event dispatching within the WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Initializes the LifecycleManager with the provided service, setting up necessary resources.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Closes the specified application, optionally activating another app based on the close reason.

methods.name: AppReady
methods.description: Handles the event indicating that an app is ready.

methods.name: StateChangeComplete
methods.description: Handles the completion of a state change for an app.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves the list of currently loaded applications, optionally verbose.

methods.name: IsAppLoaded
methods.description: Checks if an app with the given ID is loaded.

methods.name: SpawnApp
methods.description: Launches a new application with specified parameters.

methods.name: SetTargetAppState
methods.description: Sets the target lifecycle state for a specific app.

methods.name: UnloadApp
methods.description: Initiates a graceful shutdown of the specified app.

methods.name: SendIntentToActiveApp
methods.description: Sends an intent (deeplink) to an active app.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for lifecycle events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.
